Raids

Armored Mewtwo will appear in five-star raids on both Saturday and Sunday. Shiny Armored Mewtwo will not be available during this event.

Five-star Raids

  • Armored Mewtwo

Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y will appear in Super Mega Raids at certain Gyms. Mega Raid Bosses at other Gyms will rotate with the active habitat.

Pokémon caught from Mega Raids during the event may have a Mega Evolution–themed Special Background.

Saturday

  • Mega Mewtwo X

Sunday

  • Mega Mewtwo Y
